theorems.name: Submission.polyhedral_approx_density_split
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (g : Eucl P → ℝ), Integrable g μ → ∃ νpos νneg : Measure (Eucl P), IsFiniteMeasure νpos ∧ IsFiniteMeasure νneg ∧ ∀ b : Eucl P → ℝ, Measurable b → (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x, |b x| ≤ C) → ∫ x, b x ∂νpos - ∫ x, b x ∂νneg = ∫ x, b x * g x ∂μ
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
